name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began with a fascination for the engineering behind rally cars, sparked by watching the World Rally Championship as a young boy in Santiago. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, and his career started in a small Chilean racing team, where he quickly learned the intricacies of vehicle dynamics and race strategy. His meticulous approach and problem-solving skills led him to roles in Formula 3 and Formula 2 before finally joining JHR Developments.

As Technical Director, Ricardo is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection. He believes in data-driven decision-making and fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team. His focus is on optimizing every aspect of the car's performance, from aerodynamic efficiency to suspension tuning. Ricardo is distinctive for his ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable strategies that directly impact on-track performance. His loyalty to JHR Developments is unwavering, making him a cornerstone of the team's technical operations.

Ricardo's approach is hands-on, often found poring over telemetry data late into the night. He is known to push his team to their limits, believing that dedication and hard work are essential for achieving success in the highly competitive world of motorsport.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Insists on brewing his own strong coffee every morning.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
